name: glint-monorepo
description: Glint: Lightweight, context-aware command-line cheatsheet overlay & AI assistant

scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@glint/shared run build && npm --workspace=@glint/db run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace=@glint/desktop run build && npm --workspace=@glint/gateway run build && npm --workspace=@glint/landing run build && npm --workspace=@glint/admin run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm --workspace=@glint/desktop run package:dir
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm --workspace=@glint/desktop run package:linux
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm --workspace=@glint/desktop run package:win
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@glint/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@glint/db run typecheck && npm --workspace=@glint/desktop run typecheck && npm --workspace=@glint/gateway run typecheck && npm --workspace=@glint/landing run typecheck && npm --workspace=@glint/admin run typecheck
